item.title: South Korea: Balanced BoK outlook under Shin – DBS | FXStreet
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Ma Tieying assesses South Korea’s markets after President Yoon nominated Shin Hyun-song as the next Bank of Korea (BoK) governor. She argues Shin’s focus on financial stability does not translate into imminent tightening, seeing rate hikes as unlikely.

item.title: GBP/JPY slips as weak UK PMI data weighs on Sterling | FXStreet
item.description: GBP/JPY trades in a narrow range on Tuesday with a mild downside bias, as the British Pound (GBP) weakens following weaker-than-expected UK business activity data. At the time of writing, the cross is trading near 212.50, reversing earlier gains driven by Japan’s softer inflation data.

item.title: US S&P Manufacturing PMI rises to 52.4, Services PMI declines to 51.1 | FXStreet
item.description: The business activity in the US private sector continued to expand at a moderate pace in March, with S&P Global Composite Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) coming in at 51.4 (preliminary), down slightly from 51.9 in February.

item.title: AUD/USD tumbles as Middle East tensions, weak PMI weigh on AUD | FXStreet
item.description: AUD/USD falls sharply on Tuesday, trading around 0.6950 at the time of writing, under pressure amid a renewed wave of risk aversion across global markets, supporting safe-haven assets, particularly the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Gold recovery stalls as higher-for-longer interest rate outlook and Oil risks dominate | FXStreet
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains under pressure on Tuesday after struggling to build on the previous day’s rebound, as investors continue to assess geopolitical developments in the Middle East amid conflicting signals from the United States and Iran over potential negotiations.

item.title: USD/CAD: Range resistance caps gains – Scotiabank | FXStreet
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret note the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is little changed, with USD/CAD stretching its recent range but failing to sustain moves above the mid‑1.37s.

item.title: BoE’s Pill: Ready to act if necessary | FXStreet
item.description: Bank of England’s (BoE) Chief Economist Huw Pill said that he stands ready to act against inflationary pressures stemming from the developments in the Middle East war.
